description: Size delegated from the parent field. Defaults to medium when no parent sets it, though standalone usage is not supported.

Applies the quiet (no-background) visual treatment. Used when the infield button
is part of a quiet field variant.

Whether the button is disabled. Removes focusability and prevents
interaction.

Accessible label forwarded to the internal `<button>` element as
`aria-label`. Required for icon-only buttons, which have no visible text.
